name: Puppet Show: "Na Floresta"
description: A charming and free puppet show that translates to "In the Forest." A delightful escape for the little ones.
longDescription:
"Na Floresta" is a free puppet show presented at the Biblioteca Municipal Almeida Garrett, designed to engage younger audiences with storytelling through puppetry. This family-focused event aims to foster an appreciation for theatrical arts and narrative in children, offering an accessible cultural activity within the community.

Attendees can expect a performance lasting approximately 30-45 minutes, suitable for children and their accompanying adults. The show is presented in Portuguese, making it an immersive experience for local families and those familiar with the language. The Biblioteca Municipal Almeida Garrett provides a welcoming and quiet indoor setting for the performance.

Admission to "Na Floresta" is free, and walk-ins are welcome. The Biblioteca Municipal Almeida Garrett is located near the Jardim de São Lázaro, a short walk from Bolhão metro station (lines A, B, C, E, F) and several bus stops. The venue is family-friendly, with facilities suitable for young children.
